lesson: The system is consistently attempting to fade exhaustion signals (RSI divergence) in a trending market, leading to premature entries against the primary momentum. These losses confirm that the model is misinterpreting local distribution patterns as trend reversals, failing to account for the strength of the 4h bullish structure.
adjustment: Implement a 'Trend Filter' rule that prohibits counter-trend entries unless a clear Wyckoff Change of Character (CHoCH) is confirmed on the 4h timeframe.
methodology_flag: Trust RSI-based exhaustion signals LESS on POLUSDT; prioritize 4h Market Structure (SMC) over local oscillator extremes.
